items.str: The Sample Book
Chapter One
Mr. Smith went to Washington on a cold morning. He arrived at 3 p.m. on Friday, and the
streets were already dark. Although it rained all day, he walked to the old harbor anyway.
The plan had one flaw: nobody had checked the weather forecast. She called her brother,
who had moved to Ohio last spring, but he did not answer the phone. It was late; the trains
had stopped running for the night.
